snoozed.description: The threads snoozed now, soonest back first (approval "inbox-snooze"): the band under Quiet. They are in no section, so no count reads them. Absent from an older Inbox: the window then offers no snooze.

pins.description: The sidebar's pinned threads (approval "inbox-pinned-threads"), in pin order, whatever the project filter (an archived thread stays pinned). Absent from an older Inbox: the window then draws no Pinned section and offers no pin.

list_version.description: The version of this list, named by the next read so only what changed comes back (listRead.ts). Absent from an older Inbox.

session_labels.description: Each session's label by id (issue #2450; sessionLabels.ts): the rows' agents and a message's author. Absent from an older Inbox, which then reads every session as before.

agents.description: Each machine's agents (the Agents section; agentsList.ts holds them): this Inbox's group, then each linked machine's on the merged view. Absent from an older Inbox.

name.description: One line, at most INBOX_INITIATIVE_NAME_MAX characters, unique (ignoring case) among the live ones.

deleted_at.description: Set when it was deleted (the person, or an agent): cards that named it read as none; the record stays for their history and an Undo.

tags.description: The live tags, oldest first (approval "inbox-thread-tags"): the sidebar's Tags and the Add tag list; each row's `tags` names them. Absent from an older Inbox: the window then draws no Tags section and offers no Add tag. Merged: one per name across the linked machines that take tags, `machines` its id on each (InboxMachineTag).

tag_colours.description: "Show tag colors" and the person's own colours. Absent from an Inbox before tag colours.

MachineUpdateView.description: A linked machine's update, as `machineUpdateView` (inbox-machines.ts) reads what it hears from there.

asked.description: The person asked an agent there to update it (an older machine): its thread (null while held) and the agent's name.

MachineView.description: A machine as the merged list and its `machines` frames name it (linked machines, packages/server/inbox-machines.ts `MachineView`): this Inbox (`self`) and each linked one.

list_cursor.description: The cursor of its list this Inbox holds: it moves when its rows changed. Absent from an older Inbox.

snoozes.description: Its Inbox keeps snoozes (approval "inbox-snooze"). Absent from an older Inbox, and false for a linked one too old: nothing to snooze with on its rows (`snooze_old`).

launch.description: Remote launch: agents can start there (true), launch is off there (false), or its Inbox is too old to say (null; null for this machine, whose own launch block says). Absent from an older Inbox.

message_deletions.description: Its store takes a Delete on an agent message's words. Not: a Delete it refuses (422) reads "<name> needs an update to delete words · Update". Absent from an older Inbox serving the window; false for a linked one too old.

snooze_old.description: Its list was read and keeps no snoozes: an older Inbox, so Snooze says why instead of vanishing.

marks.description: The marks it takes for its own threads and agents (approval "inbox-linked-marks"; `machineTakes`). Absent from an older Inbox.

update.description: Update on that machine, from its own state. Null: nothing to say (level, ahead, this machine, or no newer release known).

OutboxView.description: A write held for another machine (`GET /api/inbox/outbox`, the `outbox` frame).

state.description: `cancelled`: taken back before it ever left (Cancel on a held launch); never sent.

words.description: A held reply's or message's words. Absent from an older Inbox.

thread.description: The thread it is about, as this window named it when it pressed Send. Absent from an older Inbox.

machine_name.description: The machine's name, kept once its link went (an Unlink here or on that machine).

listed.description: Threads the window's list holds (not archived). Absent from an older Inbox: the folder is always drawn.

archived.description: Archived threads (resolved, none come back). Absent from an older Inbox.

machine.description: The machine whose project it is (`ibx_…`), in the merged view only.

combined.description: The projects combined into this one: a link to one opens this project. Absent when there are none.

picture.description: When its letter mark's picture was set (Set picture…, ms). Absent when none, and from an older Inbox.

repo_host.description: Its git origin's host (null: none named, links as github.com); absent with no repo and from an older Inbox.

key.description: The folder name under `inbox/projects/`: `<name>-<6 hex of the root>`.

root.description: Absolute realpath of the repository root (git toplevel) or folder.

display_name.description: The name the person gave the project (Rename… in the project menu), shown as it is in place of its folder's name. Additive: absent until someone renames, and absent again after Reset name. Id, key, `name` (the slug) and root never change with it.

merged_into.description: The project this one was combined into (approval "project-combine"). Every reader shows this project's threads under the end of that chain; nothing of this project moves, and an older reader ignores the field. A target that is gone, or a loop, counts as not combined, so a project can only reappear.

separated_from.description: The project this one's last undone combine went into: Tidy does not suggest the pair again.

QuestionAnswer.description: One answer to one question. Stored as `Annotation.questionAnswer`.

prompt.description: The prompt, so the export and archive need no re-parse.

by_reply.description: With `skipped`: the Plannotator Inbox skipped it with a Send, because the person pressed "Skip them" there (not Skip on the card). Printed as "Skipped by the person". Read only with `skipped: true`.

sourceLine.description: Document line of the prompt when answered.

thread_read.description: Asked with `with_thread`: the thread as a read of it answers now (the sent reply in it). Absent from an older Inbox.

held.description: To another machine: held in this Inbox's outbox until that machine's Inbox answers (the thread shows it waiting).

row.description: The thread's list row, an archived thread's too (the window's list leaves those out). Absent from an older Inbox.

run.description: A launched thread's run line (inbox-launch.ts): null while the agent rests. Absent: not a launched thread, or launch is off.

attach_command.description: With `run`: the command that attaches to the launched session in a terminal, also while it rests; null before it exists.

UpdateCheckFailing.description: Checking for updates has failed for hours with no success (packages/shared/update-check.ts releaseCheckFailing).
